notes: SMOTE is not a baseline (only mentioned in Related Work), so no vs-SMOTE numbers exist; Table 7 (COG-OS vs US vs OS, F-measure, SVMs) recorded as closest comparison. Table 7 also prints large-class and 'total' F-measure per data set. Other results: Table 4 (COG-OS vs pure SVM recall/precision/F per class), Table 6 (COG vs pure SVM on page-blocks, k1b, la12), Table 9 (probe/r2l binary: SVMs, RIPPER, PNrule, COG-OS F-measure), Table 10/11 (COG accuracy on balanced sets with SVMs, BMR, C4.5, RIPPER), Figures 4-7. Tested classifiers: LIBSVM linear, BMR, C4.5, RIPPER. Split: random stratified 70/30 when no test set provided. COG-OS settings: 4 clusters on large class; rare class replicated to approx average size of large-class clusters (#repetitions 2-9 in Table 4; 30 and 120 for probe/r2l).
